hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT strategy pools that charges time-decaying buy fees (starting at 95%, decaying to 15%) and flat 15% sell fees, taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Collected fees are distributed in ETH to a FeeContract vault (93.33%), founder wallets, and an optional buy-and-burn mechanism for a brand asset token. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to the NFT strategy factory.
